# AI Tool Lab

AI Tool Lab publishes fixed-scope, buyer-ready AI workflow and public-source data offers.
Canonical hub: https://hirokimm.github.io/ai-tool-lab/

## Paid offers

### AI Workflow Automation Team Pack
- Buyer: operations, marketing, research, or product teams with a repeatable workflow to automate.
- Scope: fixed written scope before work starts; no hidden-scope acceptance.
- Monthly: JPY 98,000.
- Annual prepaid: JPY 980,000 for 12 months (JPY 196,000 below 12 monthly payments).
- Order: https://github.com/Hirokimm/ai-tool-lab/issues/new?template=automation-team-pack-order.yml&utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_discovery&utm_campaign=annual_team_pack_980000&utm_content=paid_offer

### Certification Renewal Radar
- Buyer: certification consultants and security-support firms.
- Deliverable: monthly CSV updates for up to 100 organizations, including organization, official domain, certification type, expiry context, and public evidence URL.
- Annual prepaid: JPY 198,000 for 12 monthly updates.
- Important: certification expiry is context only and does not prove purchase or renewal intent.
- Sample and paid-intent form: https://hirokimm.github.io/data-act-exit-audit/005/?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_discovery&utm_campaign=cert_signal_annual_radar_198000&utm_content=paid_offer

### Agency Portfolio License
- Buyer: certification consultants and security-support firms managing larger prospect or client portfolios.
- Deliverable: monthly differential CSV updates for up to 500 organizations, with public evidence URLs.
- License: 10 named users within one corporation; no resale or redistribution.
- Annual prepaid: JPY 498,000 for 12 monthly updates.
- Kickoff reservation: JPY 49,800 after fit confirmation, credited in full to the first-year fee, leaving JPY 448,200.
- Dedicated reservation order: https://github.com/Hirokimm/data-act-exit-audit/issues/new?template=agency-portfolio-license-reservation-order.yml&utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_discovery&utm_campaign=agency_portfolio_license_reservation_49800&utm_content=invoice_intent
- Scope and terms are confirmed in writing before contract.
- Sample and paid-intent form: https://hirokimm.github.io/data-act-exit-audit/005/?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_discovery&utm_campaign=agency_portfolio_license_498000&utm_content=paid_offer

### Agency Portfolio Pilot and Credited Reservation
- Buyer: certification consultants and security-support firms that want to validate a 50-organization deliverable before an annual license.
- Deliverable: one fixed CSV for 50 organizations with organization, official domain, certification type, expiry context, public evidence URL, and observation date.
- Pilot price: JPY 59,800.
- Credited reservation: JPY 9,800 after fit confirmation; credited in full to the pilot price, leaving JPY 50,000.
- Annual conversion: if the buyer upgrades within 30 days after delivery, the paid JPY 59,800 is credited in full to the first-year JPY 498,000 Agency Portfolio License.
- Structured order request: https://github.com/Hirokimm/data-act-exit-audit/issues/new?template=agency-portfolio-pilot-order.yml&utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_discovery&utm_campaign=agency_portfolio_order&utm_content=reservation_offer

## Transaction rules

- A form submission is non-binding and does not create a charge.
- Scope, price, payment method, and delivery terms are confirmed in writing before contract.
- Do not submit confidential or private information through public forms.
- Public-source data only; no unsolicited outreach is performed by AI Tool Lab.
